from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """Financial figures extracted from one company's 10-Q filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Company name as it appears in the filing")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period in YYYY-MM format")
    cash_and_equivalents: float | None = Field(description="Cash and cash equivalents amount")
    cash_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale of cash: 'million', 'thousand', or 'dollars'")
    retained_earnings: float | None = Field(description="Retained earnings amount (use negative for deficit)")
    retained_earnings_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale of retained earnings: 'million', 'thousand', or 'dollars'")
    total_shareholders_equity: float | None = Field(description="Total shareholders' equity amount")
    equity_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale of equity: 'million', 'thousand', or 'dollars'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_data: list[CompanyFinancialData]
